# Paper metadata

## Updating this reference

Edit the model and, when needed, the YAML template, then regenerate from the repository root:

```bash
./dev run --frozen python -m knowledge_base.scripts.generate_metadata_docs
```

Validate the template and check that this reference is current without writing files:

```bash
./dev run --frozen python -m knowledge_base.scripts.generate_metadata_docs --check
```

## Loading and auditing

The loader rejects unknown fields and nested values where scalars are expected.
It trims scalar text, treats null values as empty, and normalizes list fields to tuples internally.
A scalar supplied for a list field becomes a one-element list; empty elements are removed.
Years retain integer or string form; booleans and collections are rejected.

Loader defaults allow incomplete imported records to be read.
Required below means the metadata audit requires the field to be present and non-null on disk;
it does not mean the loader rejects missing fields. The audit also checks content quality.
Blank type and audit status values are tolerated by the loader but fail the audit's allowed-value checks.
New imports use `raw` for audit status; a missing status loads as an empty string.
Descriptions include editorial guidance that is not all enforced by Pydantic.

## Fields

### `title`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: yes.

Full paper title, copied verbatim and written in title case. Use a double-quoted YAML string.

### `algorithm`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

Short name of the primary algorithm, technique, or method introduced by the paper.

### `authors`

Type: list of string values. Loader default: `[]`. Required: yes.

Authors in paper order. Use full names, including middle initials when available; prefer English letters for
search.

### `year`

Type: integer or string. Loader default: `""`. Required: yes.

Year of first publication, using the earliest arXiv version when available. This is not necessarily the formal
venue publication year, which has no separate field yet.

### `source`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

Most official venue, usually a conference or journal name. Omit years.

### `type`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: yes.

Research item type.

Allowed non-empty values:

- `Conference Paper`
- `Journal Paper`
- `Workshop Paper`
- `Preprint`
- `Technical Report`
- `PhD Dissertation`
- `Master's Thesis`
- `Survey Paper`
- `Book`
- `Patent`
- `Blog Post`
- `Other`

### `doi`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

DOI of the formally published item, never the arXiv DOI. DOI URL prefixes are removed when loading.

### `arxiv_id`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

Bare arXiv ID as a double-quoted YAML string, or blank if no clear match exists. Loading removes URL prefixes
and version suffixes and preserves old-style archive prefixes.

### `tags`

Type: list of string values. Loader default: `[]`. Required: no.

Short, commonly searched phrases, one per line. Aim for 5–20 tags and capitalize the first word.

### `abstract`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: yes.

Full verbatim abstract. Prefer arXiv, then the formal publication, then another available source. Leave blank
only when no abstract exists.

### `summary`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

Short external-observer summary of the main contributions and important secondary contributions.

### `link`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: no.

Primary paper link. Prefer the arXiv PDF when available, then another freely openable paper link; use a
paywalled link as a last resort.

### `links_alt`

Type: list of string values. Loader default: `[]`. Required: no.

Alternate links, with freely openable paper links before paywalled links. May also include supporting code,
packages, and project pages.

### `audit_status`

Type: string. Loader default: `""`. Required: yes.

Audit lifecycle: raw means imported and not manually reviewed; partial means some fields checked or corrected;
reviewed means all key fields verified with a good summary. Agents may set raw or partial, never reviewed.

Allowed non-empty values:

- `raw`
- `partial`
- `reviewed`

## Example template

This illustrative example is copied from
[`metadata.yml`](../knowledge_base/docs/templates/metadata.yml) and validated against the model.
Replace its placeholder values with verified paper metadata.

```yaml
title: "Title of the Paper"
algorithm: ABC
authors:
  - Author Name
  - Other Person
year: 1234
source: Conference on Super Amazing Things
type: Conference Paper
doi: 10.1234/1234567
arxiv_id: "1234.12345"
tags:
  - Tag
  - Other tag
abstract: >
  Verbatim copy of the official abstract.
summary: >
  One or two sentences describing the crux of the paper and its major contributions and things to remember about it.
link: https://open_access_organization.com/that_guy/papers/paper_filename.pdf
links_alt:
  - https://paywalling_organization.com/document/123456
audit_status: raw
```
